translations.web: Make a ship of gopher wood. You shall make rooms in the ship, and shall seal it inside and outside with pitch.
translations.bsb: Make for yourself an ark of gopher wood; make rooms in the ark and coat it with pitch inside and out.
translations.kjv: Make thee an ark of gopher wood; rooms shalt thou make in the ark, and shalt pitch it within and without with pitch.
translations.asv: Make thee an ark of gopher wood; rooms shalt thou make in the ark, and shalt pitch it within and without with pitch.
